exposure: domestic family violence (DFV) in the past year
cohort: The study included 52,469 women from two hospitals in one local health district in New South Wales, Australia, whose routinely collected data from 2010 to 2019 were examined.
finding: Domestic family violence (DFV) was associated with poorer maternal and perinatal outcomes, including a significantly higher likelihood of stillbirth and preterm birth, as well as mental health issues in women.
mod_finding: Recent domestic family violence was not associated with caesarean section after adjusting for confounders.
